Decision: Break into 7 independent tools not monolith
Rationale: User explicitly requested independent scripts; easier to maintain/test/deploy individually

Decision: Use bash for simple scripts (1,2,3) and Python for complex ones (4,5,6,7)
Rationale: Bash is simpler for GH CLI wrapping; Python needed for Lambda/API/complex logic
Minimize token usage; persistent task state across agent calls; queryable

Decision: Each tool gets its own directory with self-contained files
Rationale: Golden rule #9 - meaningful names, keep files together; enables curl-based remote execution

Decision: Support 3 auth methods: GH CLI, PAT via curl, GitHub OAuth App
Rationale: User explicitly requested all three; covers enterprise and personal use cases

Decision: Lambda deployments for scripts 4-7 with local fallback
Rationale: User wants both local and Lambda; S3 for Lambda output, local file for local

Decision: TDD approach with mock and unit tests per tool
